environment_confound.summary: The O-side batch (single tb run, n-concurrent=4, --no-cleanup to preserve images for matched-image H-side) hit `no space left on device` on the 30GiB podman VM mid-run. run.log contains explicit buildkit ResourceExhausted/no-space errors (lines 1481, 1720, 1940-1943, 38271). 16 O-side docker-compose builds failed (failure_mode=unknown_agent_error); 15 were transient (spot rebuilds succeeded immediately after reclamation), 1 was genuine (qemu-startup: debian bullseye repos return 404, reproduced standalone). run-pdp11-code reached tests but its amd64 uv segfaulted under qemu (parse_error).
h_side_build_failures_disk: oom (2 verbatim attempts: h2, h3 — torch ~5G layer blob vs remaining disk)
environment_confound.amd64_base_leak: podman build (no --platform) reused the amd64-tagged ghcr.io/laude-institute/t-bench/python-3-13:latest that docker had pulled for --platform=linux/amd64 tasks; podman-built clients on that base ran amd64 (uv x86_64 segfault: heterogeneous-dates confirmed; solana-data, oom, simple-sheets-put-client affected). docker buildx targets arm64 for the same no-platform Dockerfile — a real builder-resolution divergence recorded verbatim.

driver_defects.defect: h1 driver resolved unqualified podman-build tag to docker.io/library -> pull attempt -> container_start_failure; no subject ran. Corrected: h2 pass = first real attempts, h1 records preserved verbatim under h-side/h1/.
runner_exception float("5s") on compose healthcheck interval; no subject ran. Fixed; h3 pass = first real attempt -> resolved.

analysis.o_side_genuine_verdicts: 13 tasks where O produced a real verdict (11 resolved, gpt2-codegolf unresolved-failed, run-pdp11-code unresolved-parse_error): directional agreement 13/13 = 100%.
analysis.all_discordances_class: every discordance is O=unresolved(compose-build disk failure) vs H=resolved — environment-attributable, none from divergent runner semantics on an executed task.
analysis.vacuous_agreements: unresolved-both pairs where O never ran (build_failure) and H failed later-stage: build-tcc-qemu, solana-data, cartpole-rl-training, build-initramfs-qemu, heterogeneous-dates, qemu-startup, oom — binary agreement but differing failure stages, recorded verbatim.
